newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ionics climbs 10.17 pct in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Ionics climbs 10.17 pct in early trade.

text.p: Philippine electronics concern Ionics Circuit Inc rose 1.50 pesos, or 10.17 percent, to 16.25 pesos in early trade on Wednesday as investors were encouraged by news of higher exports for the first four months of the year led by the electronics sector, brokers said.
"The stock is possibly riding on strong exports growth for the first four months of the year led by the electronics sector," said Jonathan Ravelas, head of sales at Asian Capital Equities.
"There's the exports angle and it may also be rising on the possibility that it will exceed earnings target for the year," said Dennis Rayala, research head at Abacus Securities.

Last week, the National Statistics Office had reported an increase in exports to $7.588 billion in the first four months of the year against $6.177 billion in the same period last year pulled by the electronics industry.
Ionics was among the top ten most heavily traded issues early in the session.
